title: Add retention policy knowledge to the privacy domain
summary: Added guidance to the privacy domain in BCQuality about registering extension-owned tables for retention policies and shipping default retention policy setups, addressing common mistakes in how extensions handle log table cleanup.
key_points: Two new knowledge articles in microsoft/knowledge/privacy/ with good and bad AL code examples
Covers proper registration in both install and upgrade code with guards, and creating disabled default policy setups
Addresses anti-patterns like hand-rolled DeleteAll and enabled policies without tenant approval
Integrated into al-privacy-review skill for detection during code reviews
References platform claims from BC admin documentation and the Retention Policy module
